title: E11.4 DMN-middle: declarative conditional visibility/validation + business rules without code
summary: Implements the Middle layer of the two-floor authoring model (extensibility-and-authoring.md §4). Given a set of DmnRuleTable definitions and the current named-binding field values, the pure evaluator deterministically computes field visibility overrides, requiredness overrides, validation errors, and routing outcomes — zero-LLM, zero-DB, zero-env. Migration 066 adds the dmn_rule_table DB table with RLS for tenant-scoped rule table persistence (draft/published status, human-gated promote).
package_json_change: ADDITIVE ONLY — appended ' && bash ci/checks/dmn-middle-isolation.sh && bash ci/checks/dmn-middle-isolation.sh --self-test' to the end of the existing 'fitness' script line. No entries removed or reordered.

migration.description: New table dmn_rule_table: id (UUID PK), tenant_id, name, definition (JSONB), process_def_id (nullable), status ('draft'|'published'), timestamps. RLS enabled, 4 policies (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), one USING predicate each (NF-1). Index on (tenant_id, process_def_id, status).

invariants: Pure evaluation: no IO, no DB, no env. Zero-LLM, deterministic.

No second PDP: evaluator does NOT resolve grants. It receives named-binding field values and returns overrides. The caller (HTTP layer) applies them on top of Floor-1 resolved visibility/requiredness.
Carries the named-binding contract: field-key == variable-name (same as form-schema.ts / floor1-editor.ts).
Does NOT mutate process state directly (carrying the §4 invariant).
types: DmnEffect — discriminated union: set_visibility | set_required | add_validation_error | set_routing_outcome
DmnHitPolicy — FIRST (stop at first match) | COLLECT (accumulate all matches)
DmnEvalResult — visibilityOverrides + requirednessOverrides + validationErrors + routingOutcomes + tablesEvaluated + rulesMatched
helpers_exported: evaluate(ruleTables, bindings) — THE single entry point
mergeVisibility(floor1Visible, dmnResult) — compose DMN overrides with Floor-1 base
mergeRequiredness(floor1Required, dmnResult) — compose DMN overrides with Floor-1 base

risks: COLLECT hit-policy with conflicting effects on same field: last-write-wins is intentional and documented; callers must be aware that rule ordering matters.
DMN overrides are advisory over Floor-1 — the merge helpers (mergeVisibility/mergeRequiredness) must be called by the HTTP/validation layer; if bypassed, DMN effects are silent.
